verdict.rationale: Raygun docs claim AI-powered root-cause suggestions and an interactive AI chat tied to a specific error, with stack trace, source-linked commits (via GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab integration) as context. However, there's no explicit mention of breadcrumbs feeding the AI analysis, no detail on how commits are surfaced within the AI's reasoning, and no independent/hands-on evidence validating the quality of the AI's root-cause proposals. missing for 10: breadcrumb integration into AI analysis, independent validation of AI suggestion accuracy, detail on how commit context is used by the AI.
